findings: The eight shipped files are byte-identical to the pinned jar resources. Each YAML front matter has an empty license field. The 31 themes already in the tree declare MIT and 3 declare Apache-2.0. PlantUML itself is GPL-3.0-or-later. An empty license field does not grant Apache-2.0, and the packet does not change LICENSE or NOTICE. sunlust declares GPL 3+ and stays unshipped. Vendoring the eight blank-license files is not satisfied.

Fresh held-out whole CLI output matches Java on 0/88 valid cases for both binaries. The packet changes 76 of those 88 and all 76 remain unequal. 54 of the 76 also fail element-tree equality after processing instructions are stripped, so the miss is not only the pre-existing version-only processing instruction. The clearest new wrong mode is hg8_plain_seq_tail_then_theme and hg8_mono_seq_tail_then_theme: Java keeps the default font on messages before !theme and applies the theme font after it; base leaves every message in sans-serif; tip paints every message in the theme font. preprocess/mod.rs is unchanged. Executing the newly vendored body exposes the order bug.
